build_LMMinGRU_model: build a language model using LMMinGRU with token embeddings, RMSNorm, and configurable weight tying
create_StateCache_module: create a StateCache module to manage convolution and hidden state buffers for MinGRU inference
run_LMMinGRU_forward: run the LMMinGRU forward pass on token values to get logits or cross-entropy loss
reset_LMMinGRU_parameters: reset LMMinGRU model parameters using truncated normal initialization with configurable standard deviation
get_no_recompute_ops: get the set of torch operations that should not be recomputed during gradient checkpointing
